description: An extensions key without the `x-` prefix. The namespace is open to extensions, not to arbitrary posture fields the closed root deliberately refuses.
adrRow: §9 schema rev — the `^x-` namespace is the seam; `additionalProperties: false` still governs the posture root.
note: The two verdicts diverge by design: this is a malformed posture DOCUMENT, not a malformed actor scope. Strict posture handling (§5.3) refuses it at document validation, upstream of branch-open; the branch-open gate reads no actor-scope key and would fall back to binary admission.
